title: CH2 triplet, ROHF/6-31G, full valence window
description: The smallest open-shell case, and the first entry where the legacy diag(orbital energies) expression is wrong for a reason other than noncanonical orbitals.

active_space.notes: Four active alpha and two active beta electrons, so the alpha/beta consistency check on h_eff has something to catch.

solver.notes: Small enough for exact diagonalisation, so this entry doubles as the truth source for the solver adapters.

provenance.geometry_source: gaussian/probe_ch2_rohf.gjf, the committed M0 probe job.
